# algolia_query_suggestions (Resource)

Manages an Algolia Query Suggestions configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Query Suggestions is region-routed. Set `analytics_region` on the provider
# (it must match the region your Algolia application is hosted in).
# provider "algolia" {
#   analytics_region = "us"
# }

resource "algolia_index" "source" {
  name                = "products"
  deletion_protection = false
}

# Builds a "products_query_suggestions" index from the search analytics of the
# source index, so you can power an as-you-type suggestions UI.
resource "algolia_query_suggestions" "example" {
  index_name = "products_query_suggestions"
  languages  = ["en"]

  source_indices {
    index_name     = algolia_index.source.name
    analytics_tags = ["mobile"]
    min_hits       = 10
    min_letters    = 3
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_name` (String) The Query Suggestions index name.

### Optional

- `exclude` (Set of String) Words and patterns to exclude from the Query Suggestions index.
- `languages` (Set of String) Languages used to deduplicate singular and plural suggestions.
- `source_indices` (Block List) Source indices used to generate the Query Suggestions index. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--source_indices))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier in the form <index_name>.

<a id="nestedblock--source_indices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_indices`

Required:

- `index_name` (String) Source Algolia index name.

Optional:

- `analytics_tags` (Set of String) Analytics tags used to filter popular searches.
- `external` (Set of String) External indices used to generate custom suggestions.
- `facets` (Block List) Facets to use as categories for suggestions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--source_indices--facets))
- `generate` (List of List of String) Facet combinations used to generate suggestions.
- `min_hits` (Number) Minimum hits required for a query to become a suggestion.
- `min_letters` (Number) Minimum letters required for a query to become a suggestion.

<a id="nestedblock--source_indices--facets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_indices.facets`

Required:

- `amount` (Number) Number of suggestions to generate for the facet.
- `attribute` (String) Facet attribute name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import a Query Suggestions config by its suggestions index name.
terraform import algolia_query_suggestions.example products_query_suggestions
```
